Join the Artificial Intelligence Group at JHU/APL to support foundational AI research addressing national security challenges.

Your Role

Here’s what you will be doing:
• Support research programs targeting foundational AI advances with cross-mission impact.
• Work on improving alignment of AI agents for human-machine teaming and wargaming.
• Train multimodal foundation models on language and sensor data.
• Develop intelligent robots using agentic AI for complex, self-directed tasks.
• Assess, mitigate, and exploit vulnerabilities of frontier AI models.
• Conduct mission-driven test and evaluation (T&E) of novel AI research.
• Collaborate within the Artificial Intelligence Group in the Research and Exploratory Development Department (REDD) and the Intelligent Systems Center (ISC).
• Engage in interdisciplinary projects with opportunities for publication and high external visibility.

About You

The company is looking for candidates who meet the following qualifications:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
• Experience supporting AI/ML research on campus or during an internship.
• Proficiency in Python programming and experience using PyTorch.
• Eligibility for a DoD Top Secret security clearance (U.S. citizenship required).

Additional qualifications that are advantageous include:
• Maintaining an active portfolio of open-source software projects on GitHub.
• Experience applying AI/ML to real-world data such as full-motion video, satellite or medical imagery, electronic health records, or audio recordings.
• Experience building applications in Docker.
• Experience developing software for robotic systems using ROS/ROS2.
• Publication of work in scientific journals and/or conferences.

Compensation & Benefits
• Annual salary range: $85,000 to $165,000, prorated for part-time employees.
• Potential bonuses, sign-on bonuses, relocation benefits, locality allowances, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.
• Comprehensive benefits package including retirement plans, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, flexible spending accounts, education assistance, and training and development.
• Robust education assistance program and unparalleled retirement contributions.
• Healthy work/life balance and a vibrant, welcoming workplace culture.

Training & Development
• Opportunities to work on interdisciplinary projects with high external visibility.
• Chance to publish research work.
• Access to a facility with over 100 researchers specializing in AI, robotics, neuroscience, and complex systems.

How to Apply

Applications are accepted on a rolling basis.

This job may close before the stated closing date, you are encouraged to apply as soon as possible

Why choose between doing meaningful work and having a fulfilling life? At MITRE, you can have both. That's because MITRE people are committed to tackling our nation's toughest challenges—and we're committed to the long-term well-being of our employees. MITRE is different from most technology companies. We are a not-for-profit corporation chartered to work for the public interest, with no commercial conflicts to influence what we do. The R&D centers we operate for the government create lasting impact in fields as diverse as cybersecurity, healthcare, aviation, defense, and enterprise transformation. We're making a difference every day—working for a safer, healthier, and more secure nation and world. Our workplace reflects our values. We offer competitive benefits, exceptional professional development opportunities for career growth, and a culture of innovation that embraces adaptability, collaboration, technical excellence, and people in partnership. If this sounds like the choice you want to make, then choose MITRE - and make a difference with us.

NOTE:  Thank you for your interest in MITRE’s Early Careers opportunities. Please be aware that this is not an application for a specific position. By submitting your information and providing your resume, you will be included in a pool of candidates for various roles across the company. If you are selected for consideration for a particular position a member of MITRE’s Early Careers recruiting team will reach out to you.  You can monitor your application status here: Workday (myworkdayjobs.com).  

Job Description

Data-driven, intelligent systems can bring immense computing power to bear, revealing insights across datasets too massive for humans to synthesize. We help our customers to build and enable those systems by creating trusted data engineering architectures, machine learning algorithms, and analytic techniques that put the power of big data at our users' fingertips while leverage deep expertise in human decision-making and collaboration to best pair humans and machines.

As a recent graduate working in data science, operations research, math and statistics, you will work with a team to apply your knowledge and gain experience with one or more of the following: 
• Data analysis and visualization
• Augmented decision making and trusted analytics
• AI architecture, strategy and policy
• AI-enhanced decision making and insights
• Generative AI and large language models
• Machine learning operations
• Applied math, statistics and optimization
• Simulation and computational analytics
• Systems modeling and analysis
• Operational effectiveness and efficiency
• Knowledge discovery
• Next-gen data environments

Basic Qualification
• Must have a Bachelor’s, Master’s or PhD degree in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Math, Statistics or a related degree/program
• Knowledge of how retrieve data from databases and other systems and tools using queries, exporting capabilities, and other effective methods
• Understanding of or experience with statistical software and data visualization tools such as R, SPSS, SAS, and UNIX shell scripting
• Sustained excellence in academic performance

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience having applied data science, artificial intelligence, math, statistics or a related learning to an internship or research/lab position.
• Experience retrieving data from databases and other systems and tools using queries, exporting capabilities, and other effective methods
• Experience with statistical software and data visualization tools such as R, SPSS, SAS, and UNIX shell scripting
• Proficiency in one or more of the following: Python (scikit-learn, NumPy, pandas, Jupyter), Scala/Java, C/C++/C#, Objective C; database design & development (SQL, Neo4J, MongoDB); AWS
• Demonstrated interest in serving the public

Clearance: In addition to passing MITRE’s employment background check, you may be submitted for a U.S. Government Security clearance.  This is determined by the Department of Defense’s adjudicative guidelines for receiving a clearance, to include U.S. citizenship. Other jobs may require vetting for various levels of agency public trust, fitness, suitability, controlled access, and special programs access determination consistent with the work program to which you are assigned.

AI/ML Modeling Engineer Intern role at Cisco involves supporting machine learning lifecycle and building scalable AI systems impacting millions globally.

Your Role

Key responsibilities include:
• Assist in the design, implementation, and testing of machine learning models to address business or technical problems.
• Help build and maintain data preprocessing pipelines for high-quality training and evaluation inputs.
• Conduct experiments to evaluate model accuracy and efficiency using standard metrics.
• Collaborate within an agile environment, participate in code reviews, and contribute to shared codebase and documentation.

About You

The company is looking for candidates who have:
• Current enrollment in an undergraduate program with 2 years relevant experience or graduate program with 0 years relevant experience in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, or related fields.
• Strong foundational knowledge of programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.
• Basic understanding of core machine learning concepts including supervised and unsupervised learning, regression, and classification.
• Solid mathematical background in linear algebra, calculus, and probability/statistics.
• Experience with data analysis libraries like NumPy, pandas, or Matplotlib through coursework or projects.
• Preferred: Experience with machine learning frameworks (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch), version control systems (Git), SQL knowledge, Jupyter Notebooks, and strong problem-solving skills.

Compensation & Benefits
• Salary range for U.S. locations: $44,000.00 - $185,000.00 depending on location and role specifics.
• Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
• 401(k) plan with Cisco matching contribution.
• Paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance.
• Paid time off including 10 holidays, 1 floating holiday, birthday off, year-end shutdown, 4 personal wellness days, and vacation time (16 days for non-exempt employees, flexible for exempt employees).
• 80 hours sick time off with carryover.
• Additional paid time off for family emergencies and 10 paid volunteer days annually.
• Eligibility for Cisco restricted stock units and annual bonuses (non-sales roles) or performance-based incentive pay (sales roles).

How to Apply

Applications are accepted until further notice. A Cisco representative may contact applicants directly if a relevant position opens.

Job Summary:

Lucid Motors is a leading company in luxury electric vehicles, focused on elevating the human experience through innovative design. They are seeking a highly skilled Machine Learning Engineer to develop cutting-edge models for processing multimodal sensor data in Advanced Driver Assistance Systems and Autonomous Driving applications.

Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models for sensor fusion, temporal alignment, and perception in ADAS/AD use cases.

• Integrate models into production workflows and debug performance issues related to misalignments, detection accuracy, and false positives.

• Build and maintain pipelines using MLFlow or similar tools to automate training, validation, deployment, and monitoring.

• Work with large-scale data collected from camera, LiDAR, radar, and vehicle telemetry to train and evaluate models.

• Collaborate with annotation, data platform, and front-end teams to ensure seamless integration of perception models.

• Drive improvements in object detection and scene understanding, both in 2D (camera) and 3D (LiDAR/Radar) domains.

• Utilize methods such as Ray Casting, 3D point cloud segmentation, and tracking to enhance detection performance and reduce latency.

• Contribute to optimizing active learning and sampling strategies to improve model generalization across edge cases.

Qualifications:

Required:

• 2+ years of experience in automotive, robotics, or a related field, specifically in Perception or ML for ADAS/AD.

• Proven experience building models using multimodal sensor data (camera, LiDAR, radar).

• Deep understanding of object detection, sensor fusion, spatial-temporal modeling, and ray casting techniques.

• Proficiency in Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, and deep learning frameworks.

• Experience with MLFlow, Kubeflow, or similar ML pipeline platforms.

• Hands-on experience with deploying models to production, debugging, and profiling for performance optimization.

• Solid understanding of 3D geometry, transformations, and calibration in the context of autonomous vehicles.

• Familiarity with tools such as ROS, OpenCV, Open3D, and visualization libraries.

Preferred:

• Experience working with HD maps, semantic segmentation, and tracking in autonomous driving environments.

• Familiarity with AWS/GCP for distributed training and inference pipelines.

• Experience collaborating with front-end and systems teams to integrate perception output into user-facing applications.

Company:

Lucid Motors is an automotive company that specializes in electric cars. Founded in 2007, the company is headquartered in Newark, California, USA, with a team of 1001-5000 employees. The company is currently Public Company. Lucid Motors has a track record of offering H1B sponsorships.

About Sandia:

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting‑edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:
• Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
• Extraordinary co‑workers
• Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
• Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
• Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten‑hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part‑time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
• Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance*

World‑changing technologies. Life‑changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov
• These benefits vary by job classification.

What Your Job Will Be Like:

We are seeking a motivated R&D S&E, Artificial Intelligence machine‑learning focused engineer to assist with a broad range of challenging technical problems associated with intrusion detection at national assets from unauthorized people, vehicles, and autonomous platforms (drones or unmanned aerial vehicles). The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of working with real‑world, messy data and developing prototype systems that can be demonstrated in operational environments prior to full deployment. This role requires a deep understanding of the end‑to‑end lifecycle of machine learning systems, from test planning and execution to iterative development and stakeholder communication.

On any given day, you may be called on to:
• Formulate algorithmic and machine learning approaches to solve data analysis and target localization and classification tasks in dynamic environments.
• Develop machine learning models and deploy them into a production environment.
• Write clean, efficient, and well‑documented code for national security applications.
• Assist data collection teams in both indoor and outdoor field settings.
• Analyze and visualize large datasets to extract actionable insights and refine models.
• Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, integrate hardware and software, conduct experiments, and analyze results to advise government sponsor decisions.
• Troubleshoot issues with existing code or simulations and collaborate with colleagues to resolve technical challenges. Update algorithms and systems based on test results and continuously improve solutions through iterative development cycles.
• Write proposals for internally or externally funded R&D projects.
• Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to identify project requirements and develop solutions.
• Communicate complex technical concepts to audiences with non‑technical backgrounds, ensuring clarity.
• Stay up‑to‑date with emerging trends and technologies in autonomy, machine learning, vision‑language models (VLMs) and uncrewed aircraft system (UAS) technology.

Due to the nature of the work, the selected applicant must be able to work onsite.

Salary Range:

$99,400 - $193,600
• Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.

Qualifications We Require:
• A Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or an equivalent combination of directly relevant education and engineering or scientific experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform independent research and development.
• Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q‑level security clearance.

Qualifications We Desire:

The ideal R&D S&E, Artificial Intelligence candidate for Sandia National Laboratories will in addition possess the following:
• Graduate degree in a relevant computationally‑intensive discipline where an independent research project was a graduation requirement (e.g., independent project, thesis, or dissertation).
• Experience in developing software and AI systems for enterprise and national security applications.
• Demonstrated software development skills and familiarity with modern software development practices.
• Proven ability to work and communicate effectively in a collaborative and interdisciplinary team environment.

Also, for this posting we are seeking individuals with the following experience:
• Five or more years of experience writing production code and leading large software development efforts.
• At least 1 year of related experience in ML Ops.
• Demonstrated ability to perform machine learning related activities such as MLOps pipeline development, model deployment, model explanation ability, uncertainty quantification, and deployment to production environments.
• Experience safely managing large, growing multi‑modal datasets.
• Strong knowledge of computer vision, deep learning, and other machine learning techniques and demonstrated use of PyTorch.
• Knowledge of adversarial machine learning techniques and current approaches to counter adversarial machine learning.
• Strong written communication skills (e.g., published research in technical journals)
• Ability to work in a fast‑paced environment with multiple priorities and tight deadlines.
• Strong teamwork and leadership skills.
• Knowledge and understanding of multi‑object tracking and filtering techniques (Multi‑Hypothesis Tracking, Joint Probabilistic Data Association, Kalman Filters, Extended Kalman Filters, etc.)
• Ability to travel domestically as needed (less than 15% of the time).
• High level of competence writing python code.
• Working level knowledge and experience in the following:
• Python and other scripting and scientific computing languages (R, C++, Java, C#, Rust, Go, ROS2/3).
• Simulation software such as Gazebo, and simulation engines such as Unreal or Unity.
• Linux/Unix operating systems.
• Multi‑sensor data fusion and coordination for multi‑hypothesis tracking.
• Active DOE Q‑level or DOD equivalent security clearance

About Our Team:

The Mission of department 6554 is to counter evolving autonomous threats to key national facilities and to improve the performance of physical security systems protecting those sites. We are part of a larger group focused on countering threats from uncrewed and autonomous systems. We address real‑world problems through cutting‑edge research, development, testing, and evaluation of components and systems to advance the science of physical security. This enables customers to mitigate threats to these facilities by improving the ability to sense, assess, track, and respond to physical incursions, leveraging AI to address current operational challenges and emerging threats, such as uncrewed aircraft systems (UAS). In addition to research, we specialize in the development and evaluation of Counter‑UAS platforms, which are critical for addressing the dangers posed by UAS. As the designated C‑UAS test agent for DOE, NNSA, and DHS, we combine rigorous testing with forward‑looking research to deliver transformative solutions for national security.

Security Clearance:

Sandia is required by DOE to conduct a pre‑employment drug test and background review that includes checks of personal references, credit, law enforcement records, and employment/education verifications. Applicants for employment need to be able to obtain and maintain a DOE Q‑level security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship. If you hold more than one citizenship (i.e., of the U.S. and another country), your ability to obtain a security clearance may be impacted.

Applicants offered employment with Sandia are subject to a federal background investigation to meet the requirements for access to classified information or matter if the duties of the position require a DOE security clearance. Substance abuse or illegal drug use, falsification of information, criminal activity, serious misconduct or other indicators of untrustworthiness can cause a clearance to be denied or terminated by DOE, resulting in the inability to perform the duties assigned and subsequent termination of employment.

EEO:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status and any other protected class under state or federal law.

Position Overview

Data Analyst - Entry Level (Remote). We are looking for the right people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Key Responsibilities
• Perform data engineering, data modeling and model deployment under general supervision.
• Analyze large scale complex business data (time series data, structured/unstructured) from various data sources and draw insights.
• Leverage common open-source Machine Learning/Deep Learning packages for identifying data patterns and/or building predictive models.
• Conduct statistical analysis to determine trends and significant data relationships.
• Keep up to date with the latest Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence advancements.
• Work with data engineers to design and construct data pipelines for reproducible analysis.
• Leverage cloud computing technologies like Microsoft Azure and distributed computing technologies like Apache Spark.
• Present results of analyses, including design of graphs, charts, tables, and other data visualizations.

Required Qualifications
• Industry experience in predictive modeling, data science and analysis.
• Knowledge of Machine Learning frameworks and packages, including Keras, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn and cloud computing platforms like Azure.

• Completion of an undergraduate degree in STEM.

Preferred Qualifications
• Master's degree in STEM is preferred.
